target_lufs.title: Target loudness (LUFS)
target_lufs.description: Integrated loudness of the output (ITU-R BS.1770). The default -19 LUFS is the level the VEED editor delivers; true peak is capped at -1.1 dBTP. Pass null through the API to skip loudness normalization and keep the input level.

audio_url.title: Audio
audio_url.description: The recording to clean. Any audio or video ffmpeg can decode (wav, mp3, m4a, aac, ogg, mp4, mov, webm, ...); a video's audio track is used (call /video to get the video back with the cleaned track) and multi-channel input is mixed down to mono. Up to 30 minutes and 512 MB. A public URL or a data URI.

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: How much of the original is allowed to remain under speech: the suppression floor is 1 - strength (the default 0.874 is the validated -18 dB). Lower keeps more room tone behind the voice; silence between words is always fully cleaned.

makeup.title: Makeup
makeup.description: Makeup gain in dB to compensate for volume reduction

release.title: Release
release.description: Release time in milliseconds (how fast compression stops)

knee.title: Knee
knee.description: Knee width in dB for soft knee compression (0 = hard knee)

attack.title: Attack
attack.description: Attack time in milliseconds (how fast compression starts)

audio_url.title: Audio Url
audio_url.description: URL of the audio file to compress

ratio.title: Ratio
ratio.description: Compression ratio (1 = no compression, higher = more compression)

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Threshold level in dB above which compression is applied (-60 to 0)

input.title: AudioCompressorInput
input.description: Input model for audio dynamic range compression

loudness_i.title: Loudness I
loudness_i.description: Target integrated loudness in LUFS (typically -24 to -14)

impulse_response_url.title: Impulse Response Url
impulse_response_url.description: URL of the impulse response WAV file (reverb/effect profile)

wet_level.title: Wet Level
wet_level.description: Level of the processed (wet) signal in the mix (0.0-1.0)

dry_level.title: Dry Level
dry_level.description: Level of the original (dry) signal in the mix (0.0-1.0)

audio_url.title: Audio Url
audio_url.description: URL of the main audio file to process

loudness_tp.title: Loudness Tp
loudness_tp.description: Maximum true peak in dBTP (typically -2 to -1)
